title: ED mistakenly raids fisherman’s house in Keralam’s Kozhikode; triggers protests

ai.summary: ED mistakenly raided a fisherman's house in Kozhikode, Kerala, sparking local protests demanding an apology and restoration of displaced belongings.

facts.claim: ED mistakenly raided the residence of an innocent fisherman
facts.quote: Tension prevailed at Madakkara near Koyilandy in Kozhikode district of Kerala, on Friday (November 20, 2026) morning after Enforcement Directorate (ED) officials mistakenly raided the residence of an innocent fisherman, sparking protests by local residents.

facts.claim: The incident occurred as part of a coordinated Statewide crackdown by the Central agency at 10 locations in five districts of Keralam
facts.quote: The incident occurred early in the morning as part of a coordinated Statewide crackdown by the Central agency at 10 locations in five districts of Keralam.

facts.claim: The searches targeted alleged hawala transactions, violations of the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), and gold smuggling networks
facts.quote: The searches targeted alleged hawala transactions, violations of the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), and gold smuggling networks.

facts.claim: ED team had arrived with a warrant to search the house of a suspect named Valappil Noushad
facts.quote: According to sources, the ED team had arrived in Madakkara with a warrant to search the house of a suspect named Valappil Noushad.

facts.claim: Due to a mix-up in identifying the property, officers inadvertently entered the house of a local fisherman
facts.quote: However, due to a mix-up in identifying the property, the officers inadvertently entered the house of a local fisherman instead.

facts.claim: During the hours-long search, family members were allegedly prevented from leaving the house or going to work
facts.quote: During the hours-long search, family members were allegedly prevented from leaving the house or going to work, while the officers searched the premises and pulled out household belongings in search of evidence.

facts.claim: When the mistake came to light, outraged neighbours and local residents gathered outside the house and protested
facts.quote: When the mistake eventually came to light, outraged neighbours and local residents gathered outside the house and protested against the agency’s lapse.

facts.claim: Demonstrators demanded that ED officers issue a formal apology to the traumatised family and insisted on restoration of displaced household items
facts.quote: The demonstrators demanded that the ED officers issue a formal apology to the traumatised family and insisted that all household items displaced during the search be restored to their original places before officers left.

facts.claim: Locals questioned how such a serious error could have occurred during a high-profile operation
facts.quote: Locals also questioned how such a serious error in identifying the property could have occurred during a high-profile operation.
